import odoolib, json, os
c=odoolib.get_connection(hostname='127.0.0.1',protocol='json2',port=8069,database='bench',password=open('/etc/odoo/api_key').read().strip())
def R(m,domain,fields,limit=None):
 x=c.get_model(m).search_read(domain=domain,fields=fields,limit=limit or 1000)
 return x
print('PRODUCT',json.dumps(R('product.product',[('default_code','=','SPP-001')],['id','name','default_code','qty_available','list_price','categ_id','seller_ids']),default=str))
print('SOs',json.dumps(R('sale.order',[('partner_id.name','in',['Cosmo Designs','Lance Engineering','Anvil Creative','Keystone Manufactory','Stonewall Exchange','Oxide Collective','Drift Society','Coral Office','Monarch Cooperative','Steel Bureau','Redstone Arena','Evergreen Pavilion'])],['id','name','partner_id','state','commitment_date','origin','order_line','note']),default=str))

print('MO',json.dumps(R('mrp.production',[],['id','name','product_id','product_qty','state','origin','date_start','date_finished','workorder_ids']),default=str))
print('WO',json.dumps(R('mrp.workorder',[],['id','production_id','workcenter_id','state','duration_expected','date_start','date_finished']),default=str))
print('PO',json.dumps(R('purchase.order',[],['id','name','partner_id','state','origin','date_order','date_planned','order_line']),default=str))
print('WC',json.dumps(R('mrp.workcenter',[],['id','name','comment','capacity','time_start','time_stop']),default=str))
print('SUP',json.dumps(R('product.supplierinfo',[],['id','partner_id','product_tmpl_id','product_id','min_qty','price','delay']),default=str))
print('PARTNERS',json.dumps(R('res.partner',[('supplier_rank','>',0)],['id','name','comment','supplier_rank']),default=str))
